title: pinus ponderosa subsp. brachyptera
intro: Pinus ponderosa subsp. brachyptera, commonly known as the Rocky Mountain Ponderosa Pine, is a subspecies of the Ponderosa Pine tree native to the western United States and Canada. The resin of this plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pinus ponderosa subsp. brachyptera resin include anti-allergic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, such as terpinen-4-ol, limonene, and kaempferol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
